notes.trap: The partToExtract argument is case-sensitive and must be upper case: HOST, PATH, QUERY, REF, PROTOCOL, FILE, AUTHORITY or USERINFO. With ANSI off (the default), a lower-case or unknown part name raises no error and silently returns NULL. A malformed URL also returns NULL.
It decodes using form-urlencoded rules rather than plain percent-decoding. A literal '+' therefore becomes a space, so URLs or Base64 values that contain a real '+' are silently changed.

It follows Java form-urlencoded rules rather than RFC 3986 percent-encoding. A space is encoded as '+' (not '%20'), and '~' is encoded as '%7E'. Do not use it to build URL path segments that expect %20.
